title: ピラミッドの静けさ ― 4500年の沈黙
style: 画風01・光彩のある劇場アニメ背景を基調にした考古学ドキュメンタリー
research_basis: Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities: The Great Pyramid and Giza Plateau
Metropolitan Museum of Art: Egypt in the Old Kingdom and royal funerary complexes
Smithsonian Institution: Egyptian Pyramid construction evidence and worker crews
timeline: Old Kingdom, Fourth Dynasty: Khufu commissions the Great Pyramid as his royal tomb and the central element of a larger funerary complex
construction lasts an estimated ten to twenty years; the original height is about 146.5 meters
most core limestone is quarried locally; high-quality Tura limestone is transported for the outer casing
organized skilled crews quarry, move and set blocks; ramps and sledges are well-supported broad explanations, while the exact ramp configuration remains debated
after burial, the pyramid and surrounding temples, causeway, boat pits and cemeteries continue as a royal funerary landscape
the Old Kingdom ends, outer casing is largely removed and the plateau weathers across millennia
modern archaeology studies evidence without claiming that every construction detail is known

visual_anchors.great_pyramid_present: Khufu's Great Pyramid as the largest weathered pyramid at Giza, stepped exposed local limestone core, not a perfectly smooth fantasy triangle
visual_anchors.great_pyramid_original: historical reconstruction with smooth bright Tura limestone casing, incomplete cap only when construction is visibly underway; never a golden capstone
visual_anchors.workers: organized Egyptian quarrymen, surveyors, masons, rope teams, water carriers and administrators; skilled labor crews with shelters and food support, not chained slaves
visual_anchors.student: the same modern 17-year-old Japanese male student used in H040-H044, short black hair, navy school coat, gray scarf and black backpack

history_accuracy: show three main pyramids at Giza in correct relative scale: Khufu largest, Khafre appearing similar from higher ground, Menkaure clearly smaller
use approximately 146.5 meters as original height; do not print generated measurements inside images
the estimate of roughly 2.3 million blocks must not become 23 million
do not present a single ramp design as certainly proven; show it as a plausible organized method among debated details
do not depict aliens, magic levitation, giants, modern cranes or anonymous chained slave armies
the pyramid is Khufu's tomb and part of a broader complex including temples, causeway, subsidiary pyramids, mastabas and boat pits
afterlife imagery must remain grounded in actual offerings, tomb architecture, solar and stellar symbolism rather than literal ghosts
do not show intact readable hieroglyphs invented by the image model

composition.subtitle_safe_area: keep pyramid apex, workers, stone blocks, tools, chambers, offerings and student above the lower 45 percent
composition.camera: one stable push, pull or hold per shot
composition.text: no readable generated hieroglyphs, measurements, excavation labels, maps, museum panels or signs

avoid: photorealism, oil-paint texture, fantasy gold, supernatural beams or extraterrestrials
perfect modern concrete surfaces, modern cranes, steel cables, hard hats or power tools
declaring one exact ramp configuration conclusively proven
a pyramid isolated from its temples, causeway and cemeteries in every scene
readable generated text, logos, watermarks or fake inscriptions
